Featured Content
This group contains the content that is displayed in the organization's Featured Content carousel.
Election Polling Places
The Election Polling Places application can be used by citizens to locate the polling place where ballots can be cast on Election Day.
Feedlot Viewer
The Feedlot Viewer app can be used to lookup where animal farming operations occur.
My Elected Representative
The My Elected Representative app can be used by citizens to determine who represents them in elected offices.
Open Data
Search, explore, discover, and download Big Stone County's publicly available and authoritative data. The updated date is for the Online Description, the actual data is updated nightly.
Permit Finder
The Permit Finder app displays tax parcel data and contains links to various permitting reports.
PLSS Corner Viewer
Public Zoning
The public zoning app allows users to view zoning district and shoreland ordinance zones.
Recorded Documents Lookup
Sales Comp Finder
The Sales Comp Finder app can be used to find comparable sales and related property information.
Tax Statement Lookup
The Tax Statement Lookup app can be used by the general public to access tax statements and the online property tax payment portal.
